- scripts/render_prompt.py:39-46 | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `ROLE_GOAL_METADATA_PATTERN` was turned into an alias for `ROLE_GOAL_LINE_RE`, changing the legacy public pattern name and adding a shim with no in-repo callers.
  WHY: Downstream consumers that import or grep for the legacy name can break or be misled; reviewers disagreed on impact (NIT vs MAJOR), so this uses the highest severity.
- scripts/render_prompt.py:434-435 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: `_identity_recall_enabled` bypasses `_env_flag_enabled` and reads `os.environ` directly with the legacy truthy-set check.
  WHY: This is functionally equivalent today, but it creates an inconsistent env-flag evaluation path and unnecessary maintenance risk.
- scripts/render_prompt.py:199-630 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: `discover_identity_source_prompt` now resolves the prompt path early and builds a large candidate set from multiple repo roots, which can select the wrong canonical prompt in reused workspaces or overlays.
  WHY: In validation containers or cross-repo layouts, the wrong metadata/template can be injected, changing the rendered prompt.
- scripts/render_prompt.py:625-657 | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `emit_identity_reinject_parse_fail` now JSON-escapes the sanitized detail, changing the stderr contract from raw `detail=...` text to quoted JSON-style output.
  WHY: Parsers or validation harnesses that match the legacy field format can fail to extract or compare the new output.
- scripts/render_prompt.py:75-552 | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The new `IdentityRecallParseError` / `_normalize_identity_recall_field` flow raises `identity_metadata_incomplete` for empty or whitespace-only Role/Goal metadata instead of preserving the prior graceful fail-open behavior.
  WHY: A prompt that normalizes to whitespace-only metadata now emits a parse-fail error instead of falling back to the original prompt text, changing the observed failure mode.
- tests/test_render_prompt_foundation.py:1023-1052 | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The refactored test dropped the explicit `identity_proc.stdout == baseline_proc.stdout` assertion.
  WHY: Without the byte-stability check, the test will not catch stdout drift in the fail-open path.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
